commands.summary: All 10 pinned trees fetched, none truncated

commands.command: gh api repos/<repo>/contents/<path>?ref=<commit> (Dockerfiles, manifests, routes, configs)
commands.summary: Read pinned source for each app
YAML parses; 10 apps present once; every citation path exists in its pinned tree; every expected field cited

notes: repo-591 nightscout: MongoDB required (unsupported mongodb). healthPath /api/v1/status inferred from lib/api/index.js mounting /status under the API prefix; moderate confidence.

repo-592 audiobookshelf: SQLite plus persistent /config and /metadata volumes. unsupported uses other-database because the family map has no sqlite key; could be labelled differently by another reviewer.

repo-593 glance: no database, but ENTRYPOINT needs a mounted /app/config/glance.yml not in the image; NOT_COMPATIBLE follows the mvp-scope rule on mounted config files. Could go NEEDS_CONFIGURATION if the analyser treats the file as configurable. No unsupported family.
repo-594 InvokeAI: GPU (CUDA default), bind-mounted root, SQLite. Port 9090 from compose and config default; no health route found. unsupported other-database is a SQLite proxy.

repo-595 kubero: appPath server but the Dockerfile is at repo root. SQLite via Prisma (schema provider sqlite), mounted config.yaml, needs Kubernetes access. monorepo true is a judgement (separate client and server packages, no workspace file). No health route found.
repo-596 DNN: .NET Framework 4.8 on IIS and SQL Server, no Dockerfile, so dockerfilePath omitted and port omitted. unsupported other-database stands for SQL Server.

repo-597 openpanel: PostgreSQL, Redis and ClickHouse required; ClickHouse makes it NOT_COMPATIBLE. worker true because apps/worker has its own Dockerfile. If ClickHouse were optional the label could change; compose and packages/db show it as core.

repo-598 akhq: no database; it is a Kafka admin UI, so Kafka is the blocker. Its Dockerfile copies a pre-assembled docker/ dir and cannot build from source alone. Health endpoint is on management port 28081, so healthPath omitted.
repo-599 OpenSearch Dashboards: root Dockerfile is a CI image with no CMD or app; needs an OpenSearch cluster. Port 5601 and /api/status from source.

repo-600 rancher: embeds k3s, many VOLUMEs, manages Kubernetes. Port 80 and /healthz taken from the Helm chart probes, not the Dockerfile (no EXPOSE); main.go default HTTP port is 8080, so port is uncertain.
monorepo labels: true for kubero, dnn, openpanel, osd; false for others. appRoot included for kubero, dnn, openpanel from the slice appPath.
